features: 104-Key Full Layout – Everything You Need to Type Efficiently: Complete standard 104-key layout with numeric keypad, function keys, and navigation cluster gives you every key required for office productivity, data entry, programming, and everyday computing without compromise.

UV Paint-Coated Keys – Fade-Resistant for Long-Term Durability: UV-coated keycaps are resistant to character fading and surface wear caused by years of daily use, ensuring the legends stay sharp and legible long after lesser keyboards have become unreadable.

Spill-Resistant Design – Protection for Busy Desks: Built-in spill resistance protects the keyboard's internal components from minor liquid accidents — coffee spills, water splashes, and other everyday desk hazards — giving you reliable protection without extra covers.

High-Quality Copper Wire Cable – Stable, Consistent Connectivity: Copper-core wiring ensures reliable, interference-free USB connectivity with a 1.2-metre cable length that suits standard desk and laptop setups comfortably without excess cable clutter.
Plug & Play on Windows & macOS – 1 Year Warranty: Instant, driver-free USB setup on Windows 11/10/8/7 and macOS. Backed by EVM's 1-Year manufacturer warranty for dependable long-term reliability.
description: Upgrade your typing experience with the EVM-WDK-315 Wired Keyboard. Designed for efficiency and durability, this keyboard features 104 keys and a spill-resistant design, making it perfect for both work and gaming environments. The copper wire construction ensures reliable performance, while the 1.2m cable length provides flexibility in setup. Weighing just 400gm, this keyboard is lightweight and portable, ideal for on-the-go use. Its UV paint coated finish not only adds a sleek touch but also ensures long-lasting durability. With USB connectivity, you can simply plug and play without the need for additional drivers. Enjoy smooth keystrokes and an enhanced typing experience with this wired keyboard. Plus, rest assured with our 1-year warranty, providing you with peace of mind. Whether you're typing up documents, gaming, or simply browsing the web, the EVM-WDK-315 Wired Keyboard delivers reliability, comfort, and style.
